divergences.published_php: The limits object does not advertise a separate workflow task completion request-body budget.
divergences.native: limits.max_workflow_task_completion_bytes advertises the actual enforced wire-request cap for workflow and activity continuation completions, independently of per-value limits.
divergences.harness: The native cluster-info comparator requires the exact field and shared-vector default value. PHP and embedded observations and frozen fixtures remain unchanged. Actual HTTP boundary and TCP refusal tests consume the shared completion-limit vectors.

divergences.published_php: An update retried under an existing request_id with different arguments returns the original receipt.
divergences.native: The same retry is refused with 409 request_id_conflict (outcome rejected_request_id_conflict) and writes nothing. A retry with the original arguments returns the original receipt.
divergences.harness: Against native, the state-updates and update-validation probes first prove the conflict and then retry with the original arguments; the SDK direction drivers retry with the original arguments, and the direction contract expects them. PHP and embedded recordings are unchanged.

divergences.published_php: A run its own code closes (complete, fail, continue as new) leaves its open activities and timers as they are; nothing is recorded for them.
divergences.native: As Core workflow#1117 (Workflow 2.28.0), the close records ActivityCancelled (cancellation_reason run_closed) for each open activity and TimerCancelled for each pending timer, wait timeouts included, before the terminal event, and appends nothing after it.
divergences.harness: Each affected fixture section names this divergence and carries a reviewed native_expected that overlays only the changed steps of its published expected; the contracts apply it for the native target alone. PHP and embedded recordings are unchanged.
